description: This file manages product notices in the Mattermost server, including fetching, filtering based on conditions, marking as viewed, and updating notices cache.

methods.name: noticeMatchesConditions
methods.description: Checks if a product notice's conditions match the current environment and user context.

methods.name: validateUserConfigEntry
methods.description: Validates user configuration entries against preferences.

methods.name: validateConfigEntry
methods.description: Validates server configuration entries against expected values.

methods.name: GetProductNotices
methods.description: Fetches relevant product notices for a user based on conditions and view history.

methods.name: UpdateViewedProductNotices
methods.description: Marks specified notices as viewed for a user.

methods.name: UpdateViewedProductNoticesForNewUser
methods.description: Marks all current notices as viewed for a new user to prevent immediate display.

methods.name: UpdateProductNotices
methods.description: Periodically fetches and updates the notices cache from external source.
